descriptions.rgb: Across the five frames, a white-and-yellow bus occupies the center and then increasingly fills the view as the camera wearer moves from roughly 4–6 m away to within about 0.5–1 m of its open front doorway. A bicycle stands beside the curb near the bus entrance, about 1–2 m from the camera wearer in the middle frames and partly occluded by the bus and frame edges. The bus driver is seated inside above and to the right of the doorway, initially several metres away and later about 1–2 m away; the driver faces mostly forward or toward the controls and does not clearly look at the camera wearer. Trees, grass, a sidewalk, poles, and distant vehicles lie behind and to the left or right of the bus, generally more than 5 m away, while parts of the bus extend beyond the top and side boundaries as the camera approaches. In the final frames, the doorway, dashboard area, and driver are close ahead and to the right, while a patterned bag or fabric enters the lower-right foreground within arm's reach and partially blocks the entrance area.
